title: Tired of one-nighters and leaving the World's Greatest Jazz Band
summary: He is fed up with travel and one-nighters, and left the World's Greatest Jazz Band partly for his legs.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Was that also because you didn't want to travel then? You wanted to stay?

Well, I couldn't travel at that time, being sick. Traveling... I was tired of traveling anyway, really. I had been fed up with traveling for a long while. I don't mind working for a week or two weeks, or maybe a month. But one-nighter things, that's out. You know? Unless it's right around town, close around, within 100 miles, or maybe 150, 200 at the limit. Something you can do right quick, in like that...
Is that one of the reasons why you left The World's Greatest Jazz Band?
That's right. And I was having trouble with my legs and things(?).
